Pivot feasibility and QC stage (no new challengers scored)

What this is: a finite feasibility stage after two null batches. It corrects documented cleaning defects outcome-blind, recomputes one reference (E01c), audits whether two literature benchmarks can be run, and drafts the next protocol. Nothing here is a validated result. Exploratory; session-1 = pretreatment is assumed (unverified); the same 164 patients were already used twice.

Participant groups and data boundaries

Corrected cleaning (outcome-blind)

Fixed QC sample: 27 recordings across strata (ICA non-convergence, cap-at-3, interpolation, too-few-windows, unflagged controls; fixed seed 0; no labels). Of the 6 sampled recordings that hit the v1 iteration limit, 3 still fail after the v2 retry (all 17 v1 non-converged fits across the cohort: 8 still fail). Across all recordings, FAA depends most on the cleaning choice (v1-v2 patient correlation 0.70-0.82); power features are stable (median 0.99).

E01c: one corrected reference (outcome-scored once)

E01c is E01 recomputed under the corrected pipeline, same model, splits and threshold rule. Mean Remitter AUC: E01 0.517 vs E01c 0.577 (paired patient-bootstrap difference +0.060, 95% [+0.011, +0.110], conditional on saved predictions). E01c's own mean-AUC interval [0.495, 0.662] still includes 0.5. Responder: 0.494 vs 0.546 (difference +0.053 [-0.010, +0.120]). Read this as E01's AUC moves by about 0.05–0.06 when cleaning changes: preprocessing sensitivity comparable to the gap between "null" and the 0.60 triage line. It does not show a biomarker. Batch 2's results (computed under the original cleaning) are unchanged and are not re-scored.

Benchmark B: DynaMix inference demonstration (no outcomes)

One labeled patient's EO recording (lowest ID, v2-cleaned), 26 channels as separate univariate series at 100 Hz, 30 s context, horizon 200. Left: standardized Pz context and the model's first latent forecast. Right: across-channel SD of the 12 extracted values per channel (my extraction: 10 mean latents, gate entropy, max gate). Pretrained and same-architecture random weights both give finite, different embeddings (mean |difference| 0.70); that is not evidence of EEG usefulness. Seeded runs reproduce exactly; different seeds differ by up to 0.45. Estimated 0.56 h single-process for the 164-patient cohort (4 windows/recording; placeholder windowing), 3.9 h for a 1,129-person reference pool.

Benchmark A: Bailey temporal pipeline

Not runnable as a replication here: RELAX (MATLAB/EEGLAB) and the original hctsa need MATLAB, which is not installed; pyhctsa (about 4,500 of 7,700+ hctsa features) publishes wheels only for Python 3.10–3.13 while this environment is 3.14, and building the source distribution would execute unreviewed build code (not attempted). The preprint methods (classifier, feature selection, whether PCA was fit inside folds) were not accessible. Any later run would be an adaptation with v2 cleaning, a pyhctsa subset and an assumed classifier, and must be labelled so.

Result figures specified for the next stage (not yet produced)

  • Paired out-of-fold patient-level comparisons with same-draw bootstrap intervals (conditional on saved predictions)
  • ROC and precision-recall curves per method, per repeat
  • Calibration (reliability) plots and Brier scores
  • nPPV with achieved sensitivity, PPV, predicted-positive and TP/FP/TN/FN counts at inner-selected thresholds
  • Per-repeat results and v1-vs-v2 cleaning robustness for every pipeline

Limits

  • Fingerprint checks are not full-content checksums of all 19 GB.
  • Component selection rules are crude and unreviewed visually beyond 3 examples; the frontal-ratio rule can pass diffuse maps (figure P3).
  • Memo-only citations are not independently verified (PIVOT_EVIDENCE.md).

Decision for this stage

Finite stage complete. Before any outcome evaluation of benchmarks A/B or the EC→EO extension: freeze PIVOT_PROTOCOL_DRAFT.md (it is a draft), decide whether to set up a Python 3.13 environment for pyhctsa, and decide whether to process the reference pool. No author contact, no submissions, no replication-set use.
